From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Sequenced interview plan / candidate wave windows (Sophia Turner)

Hi team,

We have Sophia Turner (SWE backend) for a virtual full-loop next Wednesday, 9/22. TalentBridge confirmed a 2.5 hr window from 12:00–14:30 PT and asked if we can run a sequenced panel-wave instead of back-to-back panels to reduce zoom fatigue.

Proposal (high level):
- Wave A (12:00–12:40 PT): System design + backend deep dive (Laura + Marcus)
- 20-min buffer (12:40–13:00 PT) — short break + candidate bio check
- Wave B (13:00–13:40 PT): API and infra (Rachel) + behavioral panel (fast 20m)
- 30-min debrief slot after (13:40–14:10 PT) — internal only, shared notes doc
- 20-min candidate wrap (optional, 14:10–14:30 PT) for culture/team sync or Q&A

Attachments: Sophia_Turner_Resume.pdf and a quick panel_grid_v2.xlsx with proposed times and question anchors.

Asks:
1) Laura/Marcus — confirm you can take Wave A (system design). If you prefer Marcus on infra and Laura on SD, say so.
2) Rachel — can you own Wave B + the 20m behavioral slot?
3) All — please confirm debrief leads and whether we should shorten the candidate wrap to 10m.

I'll send calendar invites after we lock. If anyone needs a different ordering (e.g., move behavioral earlier), flag it now — TalentBridge needs final times tomorrow EOD.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Vanessa — thanks for the plan. Quick note: Marcus and I can cover Wave A, but I'd prefer to flip the micro-behavioral 20m into the first wave as a 10m intro + 10m mini-behavioral so we can prime the candidate before the system design. That keeps technical flow and respects Sophia's preference for technical-first.

If we do that:
- Wave A (12:00–12:40): 10m intro/behavioral + 30m system design (Laura + Marcus)
- Buffer (12:40–13:00): short break / follow-up technical question in case we run long
- Wave B (13:00–13:40): API/infra focused (Rachel)
- Debrief (13:40–14:10): Laura to lead, Marcus notes, Rachel joins
- Candidate wrap (14:10–14:30): optional, Rachel to host if interested

I updated panel_grid_v2.xlsx with this tweak and left question anchors for each segment. I also added a debrief rubric row to speed consensus.

One operational ask: can Vanessa send the Zoom join link and a single calendar invite with all segments blocked (we'll mark ourselves busy only for the segments we own)? That tends to reduce calendar fragmentation.

Laura
